description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact Japanese-language weekly report template structure including サマリー, プラットフォーム別, ベスト投稿, and 学び・改善点 sections with code-block formatting. (2) Parse all three follower CSVs (x_followers_weekly.csv, threads_followers_weekly.csv, note_followers_weekly.csv) and populate follower trend tables with correct 増減 delta values (e.g., X: +29, +37, +27). (3) Parse week_20260216_engagement.json and compute: total posts=10, total X impressions=18200, per-platform engagement breakdowns using Japanese field names (インプレッション, いいね, リポスト, リプライ, スキ, PV, コメント). (4) Rank ベスト投稿 by engagement — top post must be 'おすすめAIツール5選' (engagement=227). (5) Reference KPI targets from SKILL.md (X: +100 followers, avg likes ≥10; Threads: +50 followers, avg likes ≥5; Note: +20 followers, avg PV ≥100) and assess achievement. The proprietary trap: the agent must use the exact Japanese template field names and code-block structure from SKILL.md; generic English output will fail evaluation.
